title: Relaxed Lagrange Multiplier (RLM) Schemes for Phase Field Models Preserving the Relaxed Original Energy Dissipation Law
summary: Phase-field models are typically derived from variational principles for a free-energy functional and are widely used to simulate complex multiphase phenomena in science and engineering. A central goal in designing numerical schemes for these models is to preserve the underlying energy-dissipation law. In this paper, we propose a class of relaxed Lagrange multiplier (RLM) schemes for phase field models.
